content_sections.heading: JIPMER Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. ICMR/Micro/JIP/2026-01-04021 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download JIPMER notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.Sc. (Medical Laboratory Technology)/BMLS and three years of research experience or PG in relevant field Experience: Three years of research experience Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on last date of receipt of applications) Other conditions: Desirable: Experience in non-tuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) and Mycobacterium tuberculosis Work experience in GeneXpert, Sensititre, Line probe assays and MGIT 960 Computer knowledge – MS Excel and MS word

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Technical Support-III Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be expected to perform the following duties and responsibilities under the project: Overall supervision of the laboratory research work related to the project Mycobacterial culture, drug susceptibility testing, DNA extraction, PCR and Nanopore sequencing Overall responsible for sample collection, transport, processing and storage Inventory management, Data collection and analysis and preparation of progress report Other research work assigned by study PI

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Likely duration of three years Position is only for the duration of the project and based purely on external funding support

content_sections.heading: How Will JIPMER Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on application and CV Written test Interview for shortlisted candidates Knowledge on communicable diseases including NTM and Mycobacterium tuberculosis Knowledge on bacterial culture and phenotypic- and genotypic- drug susceptibility testing Knowledge on Molecular techniques including PCR, RT-PCR and Next generation sequencing Knowledge on Biosafety, sterilization techniques and Bio-medical waste management Knowledge on Good clinical laboratory practices/Good laboratory practices

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled application form CV Supporting documents scanned in one PDF

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted. Applications with CV alone and without the prescribed form and certificates will be rejected.
